spans.text: Please, please...
Captain Thompson!
As the smoke fades, CMR-30 sincerely begs to the void beyond.
Finally, a familiar system notification rings out.
Battle finished. Enemy HQ 80% destroyed.
Supplementary exam evaluation—pass.
Exam progress 25%, loading next stage...
Thompson... she really did it.
In the dark, a figure stumbles towards the group.
Captain—!!
CMR-30's eyes well up with tears. She rushes towards Thompson.
Crackle—crackle—
A familiar color and gravity rush forth again, gradually lighting up the darkness.
Crash!
As the light reaches Thompson, she falls to her knees, her body heavier than ever before.
C-Captain...!
Cough... cough...
I did it, CMR-30...
We... still have a chance...
Just as she finishes her sentence, Thompson's body crumples as it flashes with red light, her body spent of all strength.
CMR-30 takes Thompson's upper body into her hands, tears streaming down her face.
Is there anything that can be used for repairs in these simulations? Or a repair bay like the one at the base?
Not as far as I know.
Ceno sighs, putting a hand on CMR-30's shoulder.
Give it up, rookie.
Even if Thompson's given us a chance, the three of us will fail later anyway.
This is too much...
Yeah.
The Commander and Kalina really have been too much.
No!
I'm talking about you!
Huh?
Whenever you run into a problem, the first thing you do is slack off and watch Captain Thompson throw herself into the fire...
If this was a real battlefield with real enemies, are you going to turn tail too?!
Are you Griffin T-Dolls or what?!
Hey, don't get things twisted! This is a supplementary exam, not a real battle!
If you can't even pass a supplementary exam, how am I supposed to believe that you'll get serious in a real fight?!
Type 80 and Ceno remain silent, exchanging a somewhat awkward look.
CMR-30 wipes away her tears in a single motion, letting go of Thompson's fragile body with a gentle touch and standing up.
Never mind... I knew you couldn't be counted on!
You two tell me what battle the next stage is based off of! I'll think of something myself!
And you think you'll be able to come up with something if we did?
Tell me!
Tsk.
This is... Paradeus' nuclear sub base, a delaying action.
The Commander and Griffin's Dolls resisted the military's offense to make time for allied personnel inside the base to gather internal files.
There are defensive fortifications nearby that were built earlier and vehicles that can be used as cover. There's pretty good concealment...
What're you thinking, rookie?
CMR-30 mulls over the information in her neural cloud, speaking deliberately after a moment of thought.
According to the "Combat Guidebook"...
If the frontline cannot hold, then we...
Ah...
Right! A misdirection! A sneak attack from the flank!
Oh my god!
Type 80 almost faints.
What? Am I wrong?
Don't underestimate me! I led the new recruit squad in a bunch of combat drills, and we passed all of them...
Don't say a single word during what's coming next and listen to my calls!
Ceno, get off your ass!
What happened to the slacking we agreed on, Type 80?!
I couldn't care less about the grades...
But I'd rather be melted down than be commanded by a rookie!
What? You think you get to lord your 60 points in commanding over someone with 30?
Shut up! We're T-Dolls! Nevermind if we're embarrassed in written tests, but this is the battlefield we're talking about!
Get up! We're gonna show her what real professional T-Dolls look like!
Bang!
The Ceno begrudgingly gets to her feet as she gets a hefty kick from Type 80.
Gather up!
Pay attention, this is the best way to approach this...
